hero.title: InstaRum s.r.o.
hero.subtitle: Prague-based company for construction finishing works, specialised building activities, property management, technical services and business support.

about.label: Company
about.title: Registered Czech company based in Prague
about.text: InstaRum s.r.o. is a limited liability company registered in the Commercial Register under file C 415103/MSPH. The company focuses on construction finishing works, specialised construction activities, property purchase, sale, management and maintenance, technical services, consulting and related business support.

items.title: Construction Finishing Works
items.description: Preparation and completion works, interior and exterior finishing, renovations and specialised construction tasks.

items.title: Property Services
items.description: Purchase, sale, management and maintenance of real estate, including rental of residential and non-residential premises.

items.title: Locksmithing and Metal Work
items.description: Locksmithing, toolmaking, surface treatment and welding of metals and other materials.

items.title: Technical Services
items.description: Technical services, technical design preparation, drafting, graphic and drawing work.

items.title: Waste Handling
items.description: Handling of non-hazardous waste and related operational support.

items.title: Consulting and Administration
items.description: Consulting, expert studies, administrative management, marketing and business intermediation.

items.title: Rental of Residential and Non-residential Premises

items.question: Where is InstaRum s.r.o. registered?
items.answer: The registered office is Holečkova 789/49, Smíchov, 150 00 Praha 5.

items.question: What services does the company provide?
items.answer: The registered scope includes construction finishing works, specialised construction activities, property management and maintenance, technical services, locksmithing, metal work, consulting, administration and related business services.

items.question: When was the company established?
